lines.text: What happens inside your body if you replace all sodas with pure water for thirty days?
A single can of soda contains nearly ten teaspoons of liquid high fructose corn syrup.
During the first three days, you will likely experience caffeine withdrawal headaches and intense sugar cravings.
By day ten, your insulin sensitivity dramatically resets, stopping afternoon energy crashes.
Your kidneys and liver stop processing massive acid loads, and your tooth enamel begins remineralizing.
After thirty days, you can lose up to five pounds of visceral fat while lowering cardiovascular inflammation.
Try thirty days without soda and feel how much cleaner your body runs.
